title: SORTBY orders keys by Excel collation (including Japanese iteration marks) and preserves input order on primary ties
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, SORTBY sorts by blank < number < text < logical < error, using Excel's 15-digit numeric comparison (except IEEE total order on qualified overflow values >= 2^1023) and case-insensitive collation on text, and merges adjacent ascending runs stably. Thus "Σ", "ς", and "σ" tie in primary weight and retain input order (1|2|3), "i" < "ı" < "İ" < Greek < emoji "😀", and the Japanese kanji iteration mark "時々" sorts between prefix "時" and "時a".
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in fn1_collation (rows 231-234) and f3_arrays (row 14), and matched across 3,000/3,000 full-bank SORTBY rows.
